mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warn_event WHERE tunnel_id = #{tunnelId} AND warn_status IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warn_dispose_task t JOIN warn_event e ON e.id = t.event_id WHERE e.tunnel_id = #{tunnelId} AND t.status = 3 AND t.finish_time >= #{from} AND t.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warn_dispose_task t JOIN warn_event e ON e.id = t.event_id WHERE e.tunnel_id = #{tunnelId} AND t.status IN (1, 2) AND t.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(online_status = 1) AS online FROM mon_gateway WHERE status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT p.point_code AS pointCode, p.point_name AS pointName, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(e.warn_level) AS maxLevel FROM warn_event e JOIN mon_point p ON p.id = e.point_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE e.tunnel_id = #{tunnelId} AND e.create_time >= #{from} AND e.warn_level >= 3 GROUP BY p.id, p.point_code, p.point_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, maxLevel DESC LIMIT 10
